entities.name: Query RlmN protein
observations: 353 aa protein; estimated molecular mass 38.86 kDa and theoretical pI 5.96.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial RlmN proteins: about 53–54% identity over 92.4% query coverage; best E-value 2.13e-106.
Contains a Radical_SAM Pfam domain at positions 106–245, supporting radical-SAM chemistry.
Sequence contains a Cys-rich motif around residues 109–124 consistent with coordination of one [4Fe–4S] cluster.
Likely cytoplasmic bacterial RNA methyltransferase; exact organism and substrate specificity are inferred from homologs rather than directly experimentally established for this sequence.

entities.name: RlmN
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate RlmN as a dual-specificity radical-SAM methyltransferase.
RlmN methylates A2503 of 23S rRNA and A37 of tRNA, producing 2-methyladenosine modifications.
RlmN binds one [4Fe–4S] cluster coordinated by three cysteines and uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine.
Annotated biological processes include rRNA base methylation and tRNA methylation; localization is cytoplasm.
EC 2.1.1.192; associated GO terms include 4Fe–4S cluster binding, rRNA/tRNA binding, rRNA adenine-C2 methyltransferase activity, and tRNA adenine-37-C2 methyltransferase activity.
